title: stoa-ctl log-tip breaks for group names containing '+'
description: percent_encode in ctl/src/main.rs:213 encodes '+' as '%2B' ('+' is not in the safe set). extract_query_param in transit/src/admin.rs:428 explicitly does not decode percent-encoding. So stoa-ctl log-tip for a group like 'alt.binaries.pictures+test' sends group=%2B-encoded name; server extracts the encoded string and queries the DB, finding no match. + is a valid group name character per validate_group_name. Any group whose name contains '+' will always return 404 from log-tip.
